text:
Elaine (Product): Quick heads-up — tomorrow at 09:00 PT we will start rolling out the AdaptiveEdge model bundle in Hosted API as a customer opt-in preview. This includes the new /v2/streamflow endpoint (streaming + tool-calling) and per-route usage controls. Please read the onboarding notes before testing. :tada:
Samir (Eng Runtime): Canary keys will be issued to a small set of orgs first (09:00–12:00 PT). We'll expand based on perf/latency signals. Note: legacy stream-v1 stays live; no forced migration during preview.
Neha (DevEx): Quick cheat for trying it out (curl):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/streamflow \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"adaptiveedge-l","input":"Summarize the release plan"}'
```
SDK snippet (js):
```js
await client.responses.stream('adaptiveedge-l', { input: 'Hello' })
.on('data', (chunk) => console.log(chunk))
```
Neha (DevEx): Docs & migration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/adaptiveedge-preview (please don't share externally yet).
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] canary deployment started for service=hosted-streamflow env=prod region=us-west2 at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Matt (SRE): Heads-up SLO owners — we added per-route latency dashboards and a canary alert (page if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m). Add synthetic tests that hit /v2/streamflow with the canary key.
Ops-Bot: Beta orgs will see a new per-route quota by default: 10 req/s burst 50. If you need higher limits for validation, request via #ops-requests.
Elaine (Product): We have an internal Q&A tomorrow 10:30 PT (30m) for anyone testing the preview — sign up: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/adaptiveedge-preview-qna. Drop questions in this thread or bring them to the session. :pray:
